description: Source code for the RuleNodeJsScriptEngine class, which extends RuleNodeScriptEngine to execute JavaScript-based scripts within the Thingsboard platform, handling message transformations, filtering, switching, and asynchronous script execution.

classes.name: RuleNodeJsScriptEngine
classes.description: Java class extending RuleNodeScriptEngine to execute JavaScript scripts, process message transformations, filtering, switching, and handle asynchronous execution within Thingsboard.

methods.name: prepareArgs
methods.description: Prepares arguments for script execution based on the message data, metadata, and type.

methods.name: executeUpdateTransform
methods.description: Executes update transformation logic, returning a list of messages based on JSON object or array.

methods.name: executeGenerateTransform
methods.description: Generates a message from JSON result, ensuring correct type.

methods.name: executeFilterTransform
methods.description: Executes filter logic, returning boolean based on JSON boolean.

methods.name: executeSwitchTransform
methods.description: Executes switch logic, returning a set of string states.

methods.name: executeJsonAsync
methods.description: Executes script asynchronously, returning a future with JSON result.

methods.name: convertResult
methods.description: Converts an object result to JSON node.

methods.name: unbindMsg
methods.description: Creates a new message by unbinding data, metadata, and type from JSON node and original message.
